headline: A 1996 executive order changed an earlier order, Executive Order 12873, which deals with federal purchasing, recycling, and waste prevention.
what_it_does: This order amends Executive Order 12873, a 1993 order that set rules for how federal agencies buy products and cut down on waste, including buying recycled goods. No summary was provided, so the exact changes this amendment makes are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: They follow the purchasing and recycling rules in Executive Order 12873, which this order changes in ways not described in the available information.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed March 25, 1996; the source does not state a separate effective date.
